MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

2. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

3. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 7
   D. 6

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 30
   C. 36
   D. 45

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 120

11. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 10
   D. 40.5

12. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 88
   C. 38
   D. 22

17. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

18. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

19. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

20. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

21. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 33
   D. 28

23. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 15
   D. 30

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
